explanation: Zero at every D1 and GO step, and at every D2 except when the agent chose a1 and reached S1 by the common route; it peaks at about 10 when the trial before was a rare transition or an a2 choice (a fresh switch back to a1->S1), most of all early to mid episode (before about trial 50), and is only about 4 when that happens later. Over a run of repeated a1->S1 common trials it drops to 0-3, and after about trial 50 it is usually 0.
